objective: Implement the minimal focal AgentFlow V0 WriteLease fix: use Linux /proc process identity (pid, start time and boot id) rather than PID existence alone; fail closed for malformed, legacy, or unverifiable leases; archive provably stale leases without overwriting prior archives; preserve atomic one-writer acquisition and token-safe release. Add deterministic tests. Do not modify client-app or execute H1/E2E infrastructure.
invariants: An active lease requires valid JSON plus matching PID, boot_id, and process_start_time.
Dead PID, start-time mismatch, or boot-id mismatch is provably stale and may be atomically archived then retried.
Malformed, legacy identity-free, or unreadable process identity leases fail closed.
Stale archive creation never overwrites an existing archive.
Two contenders cannot both acquire a recovered lease.
Release remains token-safe and cannot unlink another owner's lease.
No external dependencies; use stdlib and Linux /proc only.
All tests are synthetic/temp-dir/mock based; no Docker, DB, network, or product writes.
